# mulle-core

> The C standard library you wish existed: 30 battle-tested C libraries — containers, unicode, regex, HTTP parsing, sockets, processes, time, and lock-free concurrency — amalgamated into ONE library with ONE envelope header.

mulle-core is a release-time amalgamation of constituent projects from the [mulle-c](https://github.com/mulle-c), [mulle-concurrent](https://github.com/mulle-concurrent), and [mulle-core](https://github.com/mulle-core) organizations. The constituent repositories are the canonical sources; this distribution packages versioned snapshots for convenient consumption.

## Key facts

- One header: `#include <mulle-core/mulle-core.h>`
- One link flag: `-lmulle-core`
- 30 modules, compiled and linked once — no dependency hell, no force-link tricks
- Real lock-free concurrency: wait-free resizable hashmap, lock-free linked list, producer/consumer FIFOs, and a timestamp-based ABA problem solver (mulle-aba)
- Consumer integration: cmake `FetchContent` (preferred); a git submodule or plain clone also work with `add_subdirectory`. Consumers do NOT need mulle-sde or any code generation
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Powers the [mulle-objc](https://mulle-objc.github.io/) runtime: an Objective-C that is statically linkable, unloadable and real-time capable, running everywhere C runs; its MulleFoundation and MulleWeb class libraries are built on mulle-core too
- Tested in CI on Ubuntu (GCC, Clang, -O3, out-of-source), Windows (MSVC Win32/Win64, GCC), macOS (Clang, GCC)
- Every module ships AI-oriented documentation with keyword front-matter and inline C signatures (see constituent repos)

## Quick start

```cmake
include( FetchContent)

set( MULLE__CORE_TAG "master" CACHE STRING "branch or tag to fetch mulle-core from")
FetchContent_Declare( MULLE__CORE
   GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-core.git
   GIT_TAG        "${MULLE__CORE_TAG}")
FetchContent_MakeAvailable( MULLE__CORE)

add_executable( hello-core src/main.c)
target_link_libraries( hello-core PRIVATE mulle-core)
```

```sh
cmake -S . -B build-debug -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
cmake --build build-debug --parallel
./build-debug/hello-core
```

```c
#include <mulle-core/mulle-core.h>

int main( void)
{
   mulle_buffer_do( buffer);
   mulle_buffer_add_string( &buffer, "hello, mulle-core");
   mulle_buffer_done( &buffer);
   return( 0);
}
```

## Modules (30)

### Lock-free concurrency
- [mulle-concurrent](https://github.com/mulle-concurrent/mulle-concurrent): wait-free resizable hashmap, lock-free array and set
- [mulle-aba](https://github.com/mulle-concurrent/mulle-aba): timestamp-based ABA problem solver
- [mulle-linkedlist](https://github.com/mulle-concurrent/mulle-linkedlist): wait- and lock-free linked list
- [mulle-fifo](https://github.com/mulle-concurrent/mulle-fifo): fixed-size producer/consumer FIFOs
- [mulle-multififo](https://github.com/mulle-concurrent/mulle-multififo): multi-producer/multi-consumer FIFOs
- [mulle-thread](https://github.com/mulle-concurrent/mulle-thread): threads, mutexes, TLS, atomics

### Containers and memory
- [mulle-allocator](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-allocator): flexible memory allocation scheme
- [mulle-container](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-container): arrays, hashtables, queue
- [mulle-rbtree](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-rbtree): red/black tree
- [mulle-storage](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-storage): memory management for tree nodes
- [mulle-container-debug](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-container-debug): debugging support for containers
- [mulle-rbtree-debug](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-rbtree-debug): debugging support for red/black trees

### Text, unicode and parsing
- [mulle-unicode](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-unicode): unicode ctype library
- [mulle-utf](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-utf): UTF-8/16/32 analysis and manipulation
- [mulle-regex](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-regex): unicode regex library
- [mulle-slug](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-slug): URL slug creation
- [mulle-url](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-url): URL character validation predicates (scheme, host, path, query, fragment)
- [mulle-http](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-http): streaming HTTP request/response parser (bundles node.js http-parser)

### Formatting, I/O and time
- [mulle-sprintf](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-sprintf): extensible sprintf (stdarg + vararg)
- [mulle-fprintf](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-fprintf): mulle-sprintf married to stdio
- [mulle-dtostr](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-dtostr): double-to-string conversion
- [mulle-vararg](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-vararg): varargs accessed in struct layout
- [mulle-buffer](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-buffer): growable char array and stream (stack + heap)
- [mulle-mmap](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-mmap): memory-mapped file access
- [mulle-dlfcn](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-dlfcn): cross-platform dynamic loading
- [mulle-time](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-time): timespec/timeval arithmetic

### System and networking
- [mulle-socket](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-socket): cross-platform TCP sockets (POSIX + Winsock)
- [mulle-spawn](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-spawn): run programs without fork, system or shell

### Foundation
- [mulle-c11](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-c11): cross-platform compiler glue
- [mulle-data](https://github.com/mulle-c/mulle-data): collection of hash functions

## Links

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-core): source, README with install methods, constituent list
- [mulle-core GitHub org](https://github.com/mulle-core): all projects in the ecosystem

- [mulle-core-demo](https://github.com/mulle-core/mulle-core-demo): terminal-only demos (multigrep, logtop, mredis, windowrb, urltoolkit, blackboard, hashspace), each putting one constituent on the critical path
